title: LiftOn v1.0.10
description: LiftOn is a homology-based genome-annotation lift-over tool. Given a reference genome, its annotation, and a target genome, LiftOn produces an annotation for the target by combining DNA-level alignment (Liftoff / minimap2) with protein-level alignment (miniprot) and merging the two via a two-step protein-maximization algorithm (a chaining algorithm plus an ORF-search rescue). Release v1.0.10 builds on v1.0.9's whole-genome robustness with a third best-of-outcome merge candidate (miniprot's native CDS-only model, adopted only when it strictly improves the emitted protein), a divergence-adaptive miniprot-only rescue floor that recovers more genes at large evolutionary distance while staying redundancy-free, coordinate-independent structural evaluation metrics, byte-neutral vendored-Liftoff speed backports, and containment-normalization and write-guard fixes that let previously-crashing full RefSeq/cross-species genomes complete and validate cleanly.
